description: Comprehensive failure detection and automatic recovery system that monitors stream health, detects failures (network issues, API rate limits, Telegram session expiration, video codec errors), and automatically restarts streams with exponential backoff and fallback strategies. Includes health check endpoints, circuit breakers, and detailed recovery logging.
workflow_rationale: This is a multi-service feature requiring backend models, services, API endpoints, and background tasks. The workflow follows service dependency order: database models first, then core services (circuit breaker, health monitor), then recovery orchestration service, then API endpoints, and finally Celery background tasks for periodic monitoring.

phases.name: Recovery Orchestration Service
phases.description: Implement main recovery service with exponential backoff and fallback strategies

subtasks.description: Create StreamRecoveryService with exponential backoff retry logic

verification.command: cd backend && python -c "from services.stream_recovery_service import StreamRecoveryService; print('StreamRecoveryService imported successfully')"

subtasks.notes:
Created StreamRecoveryService with comprehensive recovery orchestration:
- RecoveryConfig dataclass with configurable retry settings (max_retries=3, base_delay=60s, max_backoff=600s)
- Exponential backoff calculation with jitter: base_delay * (2 ^ (attempt - 1)), capped at max_backoff
- Full recovery workflow: check circuit breaker → execute with retries → log to database → update circuit breaker state
- recover_stream() main method with full retry loop and exponential backoff
- _calculate_backoff() implements exponential backoff formula with optional jitter (prevents thundering herd)
- _execute_recovery() supports multiple strategies: RESTART (stop/start), RECONNECT (API reinit), FALLBACK (backup URL), MANUAL
- _create_recovery_log() creates RecoveryLog entries with all metadata (failure type, strategy, backoff, circuit breaker state)
- Circuit breaker integration: one per stream, prevents cascading failures during repeated failures
- get_recovery_stats() provides comprehensive recovery statistics from database
- reset_circuit_breaker() for manual intervention
- get_recent_recoveries() for recovery history
- Singleton pattern with get_stream_recovery_service()
- Follows existing patterns: logging, type hints, Russian comments, error handling
- Integration with StreamController for restart operations
- Database integration with RecoveryLog model for audit trail
- 652 lines of production-ready code with comprehensive docstrings

- RECOVERY_JITTER_ENABLED: Whether to add jitter to backoff calculations (default: true)

All settings follow existing patterns with os.getenv() and sensible defaults.
